# Authentication contract

Claude authentication supports stored CLI login state and environment-provided `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` or `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN`. A non-empty environment credential must make the provider available independently of `claude auth status`; its validity is checked only during a real agent call.
